parsed.rationale: The two `body` computed properties in `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView` and `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView` share a Jaccard similarity of 0.714, indicating substantial structural overlap in their SwiftUI view hierarchies. Both live in the same package (`app:iOS`) and the same directory (`WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Views/`), and neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code. The near-duplicate `body` implementations suggest a shared base view parameterised by widget family (small vs. medium) would eliminate the redundancy. A single `NowPlayingWidgetEntryView` accepting a `WidgetFamily` or size parameter could replace both, with the two existing types either becoming thin wrappers or being removed entirely.
